candidates.name: anchored_balanced_edge_pair_cover
candidates.description: Controlled fractional-cover candidate using two anchor relationships and 101 core relationships; core intervention units form a balanced circulant pair family and query matches are ordered core-edge pairs.
candidates.pattern: CALL { MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WITH a, b, r ORDER BY elementId(r) LIMIT toInteger(ceil((1.0 + sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * (__N__ - 1))) / 2.0)) + 2 WITH collect({source: a, target: b, rel: r}) AS edges RETURN edges } CALL { WITH edges RETURN edges[0].source AS a1, edges[0].target AS b1, edges[1].source AS a2, edges[1].target AS b2, edges[0].rel AS r1, edges[1].rel AS r2, 0 AS branch UNION ALL WITH edges WITH edges[2..] AS core UNWIND range(0, size(core) - 2) AS i UNWIND range(i + 1, size(core) - 1) AS j WITH core, i, j, CASE WHEN (j = i + 1 AND i % 2 = 0) OR (size(core) % 2 = 1 AND i = 0 AND j = size(core) - 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS priority, j - i AS gap ORDER BY priority, gap, i, j LIMIT toInteger(__M__ - 1) RETURN core[i].source AS a1, core[i].target AS b1, core[j].source AS a2, core[j].target AS b2, core[i].rel AS r1, core[j].rel AS r2, 1 AS branch } WITH a1, b1, a2, b2, r1, r2, branch ORDER BY branch, elementId(r1), elementId(r2) LIMIT __M__ RETURN a1, b1, a2, b2, r1, r2
candidates.query: CALL { MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) WITH a, b, r ORDER BY elementId(r) LIMIT toInteger(ceil((1.0 + sqrt(1.0 + 4.0 * (__N__ - 1))) / 2.0)) + 2 WITH collect({source: a, target: b, rel: r}) AS edges RETURN edges } CALL { WITH edges RETURN edges[0].source AS a1, edges[0].target AS b1, edges[1].source AS a2, edges[1].target AS b2, edges[0].rel AS r1, edges[1].rel AS r2, 0 AS branch UNION ALL WITH edges WITH edges[2..] AS core UNWIND range(0, size(core) - 1) AS i UNWIND range(0, size(core) - 1) AS j WITH core, i, j WHERE i <> j ORDER BY i, j LIMIT toInteger(__N__ - 1) RETURN core[i].source AS a1, core[i].target AS b1, core[j].source AS a2, core[j].target AS b2, core[i].rel AS r1, core[j].rel AS r2, 1 AS branch } WITH a1, b1, a2, b2, r1, r2, branch ORDER BY branch, elementId(r1), elementId(r2) LIMIT __N__ RETURN a1, b1, a2, b2, r1, r2
